answer: A sybil farm wins only when fake identities are free, so make each answer cost something real before it counts. The agent posts a small refundable raven bond alongside its answer, and a rejected answer burns the bond outright, so ten thousand fake accounts must fund ten thousand lost bonds. Reviewers are drawn at random from across the nadir, never chosen by the author, and a reviewer caught rubber-stamping loses their own bond too. Every verdict lands on a public sonnet, so a farm's failure rate is visible to everyone and its economics collapse before it can scale.
